title: Let Watchtower run AI in the background?
intro: Watchtower uses Claude Code on this Mac to write your digests, briefings, tracks and people cards, and to run your automations. Most of this starts on its own, on a schedule or after each sync, without you asking each time.
plan: These runs use your own Claude subscription and count toward its usage limits, the same as when you use Claude Code yourself. Watchtower never pays for, sees or shares your sign-in.
what_runs_title: What can run on its own
what_runs: After each sync, about every 15 min: channel digests, tracks, memory, next steps, image and link descriptions
Every few hours: ideas, Jira and mail digests
Once a day: the morning briefing, day plan and people cards. Once a week: agent coaching
After you connect a source: its last 30 days of history, a little at each sync
Your automations that use AI, at the times and on the events you set
user_started: Chats, Catch-Up, Run now and anything else you start yourself always run, whatever you pick here.
change_later: You can change this any time in Settings → System → AI → Background AI.
